# MigdalKadanoffHierarchicalLattice

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A hierarchical lattice constructed via recursive bond-moving and decimation transformations, used to study spin systems on non-translationally-invariant topologies. Provides a tractable model for investigating how hierarchical topology affects phase transitions and spin-glass order, relevant for designing robust computational substrates.
